defs.def: to make sb laugh or smile 逗笑；逗乐

ex.s: His father frequently amused the boy with a tablet computer which was loaded with colorful pictures that come alive when you poke them.
ex.t: 他父亲常用平板电脑逗他开心，那上面装载着五彩缤纷、戳一下就会动起来的图片。

ex.s: To amuse the readers with a funny story.
ex.t: 用一个有趣的故事逗乐读者。

ex.s: The reason was to amuse people and make them smile.
ex.t: 原因是为了让人们开心，让他们微笑。

ex.s: Some students are amused by something else.
ex.t: 有些学生被别的事情逗乐了。

ex.s: He has a reputation for constantly encountering awkward situations, which greatly amuses audiences of all nationalities and funny acts that rely purely on body language that is universal.
ex.t: 他以经常陷入尴尬处境而闻名，这极大地逗乐了各国观众，也以纯粹依靠通用肢体语言的滑稽表演著称。

defs.def: to make time pass pleasantly for sb/yourself （提供）消遣；（使）娱乐

ex.s: Of course, Disneyland also has many exciting rides to amuse you, from enormous swinging ships to scary freefall drops.
ex.t: 当然，迪士尼乐园也有许多令人兴奋的游乐设施来供你消遣，从巨大的摇摆船到可怕的自由落体。

ex.s: After lunch the residents and the young volunteers amused themselves with art activities which included Chinese painting and said he hoped to return to the nursing home regularly to spend time with the seniors that he made friends with.
ex.t: 午饭后，居民们和年轻的志愿者们通过包括中国画在内的艺术活动自娱自乐，他说希望能定期回到养老院，与结交的老人们共度时光。

chunks.cn: 逗笑男孩 / 逗笑人们 / 逗笑观众
